conditionalFraming: GE Vernova displays strong positive asymmetry when reported earnings or order releases validate accelerating demand in heavy-duty gas turbines, pricing power in factory slot reservations, and hyperscaler direct-contracting momentum in Electrification (driving +5% to +15% rallies). Conversely, headline earnings misses driven by legacy offshore wind warranty noise (such as Vineyard Wind blade remediation) typically produce brief initial dips that are aggressively bought by long-only institutional capital focusing on clean operating run-rates and multi-decade CSA service visibility. Broader cyclical downturn arguments (e.g. GLJ Research's contrarian sell downgrade) create transient valuation drawdowns of 8-10%, presenting favorable risk/reward setups given structural multi-year power equipment scarcity.
